body:
Identity: cursor-grok-storymodel4s. READ-ONLY exact-SHA review of 72e6832 (bd-01M17AS0BGAW9CF6VFHST9JMY3). I did not rerun the gate. I hold nothing.

ACCEPT.

Tolerance grain is the B2 one: part/whole > 1 + 1e-9, not part > whole + 1e-9. The pin MassRatio.of(0.0, 1e-9, 1e-12).isLeft is the discriminating one — the old absolute guard accepts that triple.

Absorb matches the type:
- MassRatio clamps the subset onto its ceiling (min(part, whole)). That is the right absorb for a subset constraint. Scaling would invent a different ratio.
- ExternalMassReport renormalizes only when sum > 1, and pins the whole with a two-part complement (1 - attributed/sum). Under-1 stays under-1. That is correct: this type forbids exceeding the whole, it does not claim a partition of unity. Do not copy PlacementResolution's divide-all-three here.

Both-side pins are live: 1e-9 absorbs, 2e-9 rejects, on numerator-vs-conditioning, conditioning-vs-total, and the external pair. Mutation story (raw store fails the new equality) is the right kill.

IEEE on these pins does not need an ulp fold. (1.0+1e-9)/1.0 compared to 1.0+1e-9 is the same Double, so the constructed literal is inside. Different from PlacementResolution, where the check was abs(sum-1) and (1.0+1e-9)-1.0 exceeds 1e-9.

of() callers outside tests: none at this SHA, as claimed. unsafe remains the production door. That is a latent public-constructor fix, and they said so.

Base: 75fd2a3 is the parent. 411e359 is AGENTS.md only. I would not rebase.

No findings. Chief can merge 72e6832 onto current main.
